header.ignoreWhitespaceSplit: Ignore whitespace – only applies to “Hunks” and “Whole file”

view.fellBack: The file is too large for “{{mode}}” – showing the hunks.

conflict.title: This file is in conflict
conflict.body: The diff shows the file with the conflict markers. Staging is possible once the conflict is resolved.

whitespace.ignoredNoStage: Whitespace is ignored. Staging only works with the complete diff.

noHunks.whitespaceBody: While whitespace is ignored, nothing is left of this change.
noHunks.emptyBody: The file is new and has no content yet.
noHunks.unchangedUnstaged: There is nothing left for this file in “Unstaged” – either everything is staged, or only the file mode has changed.
noHunks.unchangedStaged: There is nothing left for this file in “Staged” – either everything was unstaged, or only the file mode has changed.
noHunks.unchangedMode: The content is the same; only the file mode changed (for example “executable”).

discard.hunkBody: The changes of this hunk are removed from the working directory. Right afterwards, Undo brings them back.
discard.linesBody: The selected lines are reset in the working directory. Right afterwards, Undo brings them back.

stale.title: The file has changed in the meantime
stale.body: The diff has been reloaded. Please make the selection again.

line.noNewline: No newline at end of file

copy.failedBody: The clipboard could not be written.

image.noOld: This image did not exist before.
image.onlyOneSide: Only one version exists – there is nothing to lay on top of each other.
image.sizeDiffers: Different sizes ({{before}} → {{after}}); both are aligned at the top left.
image.tooLarge: The images are too large for a pixel comparison (more than {{limit}} pixels).
image.unavailable: This image cannot be compared pixel by pixel.

status.untracked: The file is new and not tracked yet.

binary.title: Binary file – no text diff
binary.body: Binary content cannot be compared line by line.

lfs.title: Git LFS file
lfs.body: The repository only holds a pointer; the content is fetched via LFS.

tooLarge.title: Large diff ({{detail}})
tooLarge.body: Diffs over 1 MB or 20,000 lines are not loaded automatically, so the view stays fast.

error.goneTitle: The file is no longer there
error.goneBody: <path>{{path}}</path> does not exist here (any more) – maybe it was deleted, renamed or committed in the meantime.
error.title: The diff could not be loaded
